Returns cursor-paginated conversation inbox for the authenticated user.
Default state is "active". Use ?state=pending to fetch message requests.
Cursor is the next_cursor value from the previous response — pass it back as-is.

parameters.description: Participant state: active (default) | pending | ignored | muted
parameters.name: state

post.description:
Creates a new direct (1-on-1) conversation between the authenticated user and the target user.
If a direct conversation between them already exists, the existing one is returned (200).
The recipient's initial state is "pending" unless they already follow the sender, in which case it is "active".

Creates a new group conversation with the authenticated user as admin.
If client_conv_id is provided and a conversation with that key already exists, the existing one is returned (200).

200.description: Existing conversation returned (idempotent retry via client_conv_id)

get.description:
Returns a single conversation the authenticated user is a participant of.
Includes unread count from Redis. LastMessage is populated once message layer is implemented.

patch.description:
Updates a group conversation's name and/or avatar. Only admins can update group info.
At least one field (name or avatar_key) must be provided.

parameters.description: Fields to update (at least one required)
parameters.name: body

post.description:
Moves the caller's participant state from pending or ignored to active.
Used when a user manually accepts a message request.

Adds a new member to a group conversation. Only admins can add members.
The new member's state is "active" if they follow the actor, otherwise "pending".

delete.description: Removes a member from a group conversation. Admins can remove any member. Any member can leave (remove themselves).

patch.description: Promotes or demotes a group member. Only admins can change roles. An admin cannot change their own role.

get.description:
Returns cursor-paginated messages for a conversation the authenticated user is a participant of.
Messages are returned newest-first. Pass next_cursor from the previous response to paginate.

post.description:
Sends a message to a conversation. The authenticated user must be an active or pending participant.
Pending senders are implicitly accepted on first message. Supports idempotency via client_msg_id.
For non-text types (image, video, audio, file), content must be a valid MinIO object key.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a message. Only the original sender can delete. Content is cleared but the message row is preserved for thread context.

patch.description: Updates the content of a message. Only the original sender can edit. Deleted messages cannot be edited.

post.description:
Adds an emoji reaction from the authenticated user to the specified message.
Allowed reactions: like | love | haha | wow | sad | angry
Deleted messages cannot be reacted to.
post.summary: Add a reaction to a message

delete.description:
Removes the authenticated user's reaction from the specified message.
Deleted messages cannot be modified.
delete.summary: Remove a reaction from a message

delete.description:
Sets the unread count to 1 for the authenticated user. Private reminder only — does NOT roll back
the seen status visible to other participants. Once a message is seen, it remains seen for the sender.

patch.description:
Resets unread count to 0 and updates the authenticated user's last-read pointer to the conversation's latest message.
No request body needed. The server derives the latest message from the conversation state.

get.description:
Returns a cursor-paginated list of posts from users the authenticated user follows.
Posts are ordered from newest to oldest based on their creation timestamp.
On the first request, omit the cursor (or set it to 0) to get the latest posts.
To paginate, pass the `next_cursor` from the previous response as the `cursor` param.

parameters.description: Cursor for pagination (Unix millisecond timestamp of the last post in previous page). Omit or set 0 for first page.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: Number of posts to return (default: 20, max: 50)
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Check the health status of the application components

post.description:
Generates a list of presigned URLs and policy signatures for direct file upload to MinIO/S3.

**Client Integration:**
* **Target:** Send a `POST` request to the returned `upload_url`.
* **Payload:** Use `multipart/form-data`. Append all fields from `form_data` (must be FIRST) followed by the file binary (must be LAST).
* **Success:** Upon successful upload (HTTP 204), confirm the `object_key` with the Backend database.
Create a new post with content and optional media attachments.
